entities.summary: Eric R. Scerri is an American chemist, writer and philosopher of science of Maltese origin. He is a lecturer at the University of California, Los Angeles; and the founder and editor-in-chief of Foundations of Chemistry, an international peer-reviewed journal covering the history and philosophy of chemistry, and chemical education.
